description: Deletes an expense, payment, checklist item or place that this participant added; entries added by others cannot be removed. Use when the user asks to delete a specific entry, for example to correct a mistake.

id.description: expense_id / payment_id (get_expenses), item_id (get_checklist) or place_id (get_plan). For items and places the exact text/name also works.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

name: remove_entry
title: Remove something you added
